sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed seeking the following relief:
"...to issue an order / direction or any appropriate writ more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the Memo / Lr. No.F/04/2016 Dtd 19.02.2016 issued by the 3rd respondent refusing the petitioners' representation Dtd 31.12.2015 to refer the matter to the competent Civil Court U/s 18 of The Land Acquisition Act,
1894 in respect of the petitioners lands in Sy Nos.111, 119, 124/A, 118/D and 118/C situated at Gopalraopalle H/o Mallapur (V), Gangadhara (M), Karimnagar District which are acquired for the purpose of excavating Minor 5R of Major 1 L/DL from Kodimial Tank to Fazilnagar Tank Main Canal under Stage.II, Phase.I of Sripadasagar Project (Yellampalli) as illegal, unjust and in violation of Articles 14 and 300-A of the Constitution of India and consequently direct the respondents herein to refer the matter to the competent Civil Court U/s 18 of The Land Acquisition Act 1894 for determination of compensation in respect of the petitioners above lands and pass such other order/s..."

2. Heard Sri G.Narayana, learned counsel, representing Sri Jithender Rao Veeramalla, learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Irrigation, appearing on behalf of respondent No.1 and the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition,
appearing on behalf of respondent Nos.2 and 3.
3.

Facts giving rise to filing of this writ petition briefly stated are that the petitioners are claiming that they are the owners and possessors of the agricultural lands to an extent of Ac.2-12 guntas in Sy.No.111, Ac.2-19 guntas in Sy.No.119, Ac.3-09 guntas in Sy.No.124/A, Ac.0-29 guntas in Sy.No.118/D, Ac.0-25 guntas in Sy.No.118/C and Ac.0-04 guntas in Sy.No.118/C respectively.

Respondent No.3 initiated the proceedings exercising the powers conferred under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act') and issued Notification under the provisions of Section 4(1) of the Act, on 23.04.2011 and 24.04.2011 and thereafter issued Declaration under the provisions of Section 6 of the Act on 25.04.2011.
Subsequently Award was passed under Section 11(2) of the Act on 15.11.2012.

Thereafter the petitioners have submitted representation on 31.12.2015 before respondent No.3 requesting him to refer the matter to the competent Civil Court for determination of the market value as the authorities awarded meager amount.

Respondent No.3 without properly considering the representation submitted by the petitioners, issued the impugned memo/letter No.F/04/2016, dated 19.02.2016 rejecting the claim Kola Laxminarayana, vs The State Of Telangana Irrigation Dept, on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141417242/
1 of the petitioners.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The action of respondent No.3 is contrary to the provisions of the Act.

4. Per contra, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition submitted that respondent No.3 passed the Award exercising the powers conferred under Section 11(2) of the Act,
with the consent of the petitioners.
Hence, the petitioners are not entitled to seek reference under Section 18 of the Act.
5. This Court considered the rival submissions made by the respective parties and perused the material available on record.

It is not in dispute that respondent No.3 while exercising the powers conferred under the provisions of the Act and with the consent of the petitioners passed the Award on 15.11.2012 under Section 11(2) of the Act.

Hence, this Court is of the view that the petitioners are not entitled to seek reference under Section 18 of the Act and there are no grounds to interfere with the impugned memo rejecting the claim of the petitioners issued by respondent No.3, exercising the powers conferred under Section 226 of the Constitution of India.
6. Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.

JUSTICE J.SREENIVAS RAO, J Date: 07.02.2025 pgp Kola Laxminarayana, vs The State Of Telangana Irrigation Dept, on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141417242/
